2608.18715.title: The Impact of CutMix on Reliability and Robustness in Semantic Segmentation
2608.18715.paper_summary: Ensuring not only high accuracy but also reliable and robust predictions is critical for the deployment of semantic segmentation models in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Despite the widespread use of CutMix - a simple yet powerful data augmentation strategy - its effect on the reliability and robustness in dense predictions tasks remains unexplored. Motivated by recent findings that semi-supervised segmentation methods, where CutMix is a core component, can severely degrade reliability, this study isolates and systematically analyzes the influence of CutMix on segmentation accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty quality. We evaluate two representative architectures, the CNN-based DeepLabV3+ and the transformer-based SegFormer, across both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios. Our results show that CutMix has only a minor impact on segmentation accuracy but consistently improves the reliability, particularly under distribution shifts. These improvements indicate that CutMix primarily enhances the trustworthiness of the model's calibration and uncertainty rather than the raw segmentation prediction itself. This distinction is crucial for safety-critical deployment, where reliable confidence estimates are as important as raw performance.
2608.18715.paper_summary_zh: 確保高準確性以及可靠且穩健的預測對於在安全關鍵應用（如自動駕駛）中部署語義分割模型至關重要。儘管 CutMix 這種簡單但強大的數據增強策略被廣泛使用，但它對於密集預測任務中的可靠性和穩健性的影響仍然未被探索。受到最近研究結果的啟發，這些結果顯示 CutMix 作為核心組件的半監督分割方法可能會嚴重降低可靠性，本研究獨立並系統地分析 CutMix 對分割準確性、校準和不確定性質量的影響。我們在內部和外部場景中評估了兩個代表性架構，基於 CNN 的 DeepLabV3+ 和基於Transformer的 SegFormer。我們的結果顯示 CutMix 對分割準確性的影響微乎其微，但在分佈轉變下卻持續改善了可靠性。這些改善表明 CutMix 主要增強了模型的校準和不確定性的可信度，而非原始的分割預測本身。這一區別對於安全關鍵的部署至關重要，因為可靠的信心估計與原始性能同樣重要。
2608.18715.author: Steven Landgraf et.al.
